title: Rebuild legacy test objects after any library header edit
problem: Legacy test rules watched only base.hpp, so changing an internal header could silently rerun a stale binary.
example:
touch include/ffmt/detail/parse.hpp
make test-host # recompiles affected objects
design: Use the complete installed header list in the existing shared prerequisite variable; exercise an unchanged object and a subsequent internal-header edit with real Make timestamp decisions.
tradeoffs: This conservative dependency list rebuilds some tests that do not instantiate the edited header, in exchange for reliable incremental checks.
